Every active staff role may now CREATE (author=self) and edit what they author; editing OTHERS' appointments stays PL-09 read-scope-bounded (author-specific escape). Availability made ADVISORY (owner ruling): booking outside a therapist's hours warns but never blocks; real therapist/room double-bookings + time_off still block (Save anyway). REPRO failing->passing proven live on the local synthetic DB by policy swap; full DB isolation 452/452 on 0049. APPLY-BEFORE-MERGE honoured (0046 lesson): PR #705 DRAFT until owner terminal apply + independent read (created_by escape live, count 48->49), then merged. Open follow-ups: Q-PL-11-1 (author-specific vs fully-open cross-clinic edit, default author-only) + Q-PL-11-2 (located-role e2e; DB isolation test carries the repro today). Dispatched as 'PL-09' but renumbered PL-11 (PL-09 = location model, shipped).

cards.title: Appointment notes editable in place + last-edited stamp (owner ruled: editable)

evidence.ref: migration 0050 applied to prod dfotoodqvmjhbdcxyaxf under apply-before-merge (detached-checkout apply, fixing the 0049 no-op); independent read confirms edited_at + last_edited_by present, appointment_notes_tenant_update policy added, DELETE still denied; drizzle count 49 -> 50; PR #709 merged

cards.notes: SHIPPED - owner ruled 2026-07-30 'make them editable with last-edited stamps' (Q-PL-13-1 answered, the non-default option). BUILT, apply-before-merge (migration 0050): appointment_notes gains edited_at (NULL=never edited) + last_edited_by + an in-tenant UPDATE policy (appointment_notes_tenant_update); DELETE still denied (editable, never deletable; created_at never rewritten). editAppointmentNoteAction = patients:write + the same W10-04 therapist own-patient re-check as the append path; any staff with patients:write may edit ('edit freely'), last_edited_by records who. Profile Notas thread gets a pen affordance (NotesList) + 'Editada por X · <datetime>' stamp; legacy patient_note_revisions rows stay read-only. RLS PROVEN on local (supabase db reset applied 0050 clean; 102 assertions: in-tenant UPDATE allowed, cross-tenant + DELETE denied). Unit test (therapist scope/trim/blank/reception) + e2e edit-flow (edit->stamp->survives re-read). Gates green: typecheck, lint 0-err, web unit 1424, build, journal 50/50, supabase sync. NOT in scope: the legacy backfill (pre-W12-13 rows -> editable = a separate 0051 follow-up) and converting the agenda drawer / Marcacoes popup into editable threads (they stay single-coalesced-note). Flips to shipped when Ivan applies 0050 + merges. ORIGINAL HELD CONTEXT: dispatched as 'PL-08 appointment notes thread' (renumbered PL-13; PL-08 = shipped Ativar-login #691, notes-unification = shipped W12-13 #654/#656/#657). The thread already exists: each note carries author+created, and the 'notes never reach patient PDFs/Declaracoes/portal' negative assertion is CLEAN + CI-guarded (notes-privacy.test.ts). HELD on Q-PL-13-1 (owner ruling): the shipped model is APPEND-ONLY/immutable (appointment_notes SELECT+INSERT only, an edit = a NEW appended row; no edited_at/last_edited_by). The dispatched DoD wants literal edit-in-place with last-edited stamps = ADD edited_at+last_edited_by columns + an UPDATE RLS policy (append-only EXCEPTION) + an edit path, i.e. relaxing the immutability invariant (hard rule #4 territory). Also DoD 'patient-profile Notas strictly read-only' would REMOVE a shipped composer surface. RECOMMENDATION (default): KEEP append-only, treat the newest row as the latest edit (author+created already shown), reconcile the DoD wording - no immutability change; confirm whether to remove the profile composer. The 0050 backfill (legacy appointments.notes + patient_note_revisions -> appointment_notes as note-one, idempotent/append-only) is READY to build but its column shape is coupled to this ruling, so it is BLOCKED on it. 'Nothing lost' holds at read time today (coalesce + dedup). Dispatch-note PR #707 merged (records the hold). NEXT FREE migration = 0050 (NOT 0047 as the dispatch guessed; 0047 = patients RLS, applied).

cards.title: Implicit location - remove every location picker a single-location staffer should never see (Lurdes CR)
cards.notes: SHIPPED (#713, GREEN self-merge on green CI, non-migration). ONE rule now governs every location control: it renders only when it offers MORE THAN ONE real choice. Exactly one reachable clinic -> no control at all, the id pinned server-side (scopedLocationId / effectiveLocationId, so a hand-typed ?location=<other clinic> is not honoured either) and the name printed as a static chip; several -> a picker restricted to the viewer's own set; unrestricted viewer (owner / unassigned) unchanged. The decision is one pure module, lib/auth/location-choice.ts, unit-tested to 26 assertions incl. the stale-assignment fallback (never render an empty control). SURFACES swept: Agenda toolbar, Marcacoes, Faturacao, Estatisticas, the booking drawer's Localizacao field, the Equipa filter, and the per-day location select in BOTH schedule editors (value still posts via a hidden input). TWO DEFECTS FIXED: (a) the Equipa filter was fed the TENANT-wide location list - that is how Lurdes, LV-only, was offered Castelo Branco - and its member-location index now unions availability_templates with staff_locations (only 5 of 11 members hold hours, so the hours-only index hid most of a real team); (b) the Agenda therapist dropdown listed all 16 staff incl. CB-only therapists, the 'Phase 1b' the PL-09 comment deferred - now narrowed to the viewer's clinics, with unassigned therapists KEPT (a data-entry gap must not silently hide a colleague). NOT changed, deliberately: the Gerir modal's clinic-membership checkboxes - that surface SETS the membership everything else reads, and setStaffLocations writes exactly the posted set, so narrowing it would silently drop a member's other-clinic membership. Gates: typecheck, lint 0-err, web unit 1445, build 4/4, Playwright + DB-gated RLS green in CI (one earlier E2E run failed on degraded runners; the rerun passed clean, no code change).

cards.title: Diagnose: 3 patients invisible to Lurdes (Alfredo, Joao Miguel, Maria Alice) - prod read-only evidence
cards.notes: STAGED, awaiting the owner's paste. READ-ONLY prod script at ~/osteojp-mailbox/staged/cyan-pl15a-patient-location-READONLY-20260730.mjs (SET TRANSACTION READ ONLY + rollback; prints no NIF/phone/email; run from the prod-apply worktree's packages/db with DATABASE_URL_DIRECT in the owner's own shell). It prints, per patient, primary_location_id + appointment count by location + created_by, and counts the NULL-and-zero-appointment remainder that 0051 cannot infer. THE CAUSE IS ALREADY IDENTIFIED AND FIXED FORWARD by PL-15b (#714): the create-patient form never sent primaryLocationId, so every patient registered since 0045 is location-less and, under 0047, visible only to its creator and the owner until a located appointment exists - exactly the Alfredo / Joao Miguel / Maria Alice shape. This card now exists to CONFIRM that on prod data and to size the 0051 backfill, not to decide the fix.

cards.title: Patient location: chosen at creation (auto for single-location staff), shown in the ficha, and backfilled
cards.notes: SHIPPED (#714, non-migration half). The create AND edit forms now carry the patient's clinic under the PL-14 rule: auto-applied and shown as a static line for a single-clinic staffer, a REQUIRED picker over their own clinics for a multi-clinic one, the full list for the owner; on edit an existing value always wins, so a patient is never silently moved. updatePatient + parseUpdatePatient now accept primaryLocationId (create-only before) with the same server-side tenant check - this is also how the owner will assign the zero-appointment remainder 0051 cannot infer (Q-PL-15-1). The clinic is now visible on the patients list secondary line and the ficha identity line; a patient with none shows nothing there rather than a guess. E2E CAUGHT A REAL REGRESSION: making the clinic required broke ~10 specs because the shared fillPatientForm helper did not fill the new field - fixed in the same PR, plus a new spec asserting the picker is required and the chosen clinic reaches the profile. STILL OPEN as the migration half: 0051 backfills existing NULL rows from each patient's most recent appointment (apply-before-merge, next free number 0051, waits on PL-15a).

cards.title: Appointment notes = a real thread in the booking panel ('Adicionar nota' + stamped board)
cards.notes: SHIPPED (#715, NO migration). The booking panel's single 'Notas' textarea is replaced by a real thread board: 'Adicionar nota' above the list, every note stamped with its author + date/time, newest first, the PL-13 pen edit and 'Editada por' stamp, nothing ever overwritten and DELETE still denied. The thread already existed in the data - every save has APPENDED an appointment_notes row since W12-13 - the drawer was simply rendering only the latest row in a textarea, which read as one overwritable note. Reuses the profile's NotesList (one authorship/stamp format, no second notes UI); the composer is a div, not a form, because the board renders INSIDE the appointment form and a nested form would submit the appointment instead of the note. New read listAppointmentNotes + getAppointmentNotesAction carry the same authority as every note path (patients:read + the W10-04 therapist own-patient re-check via getPatient, so a forged appointment id returns an empty thread). CREATE mode keeps the single field: there is no appointment row yet to thread onto. i18n appointment.notesEmpty pt+en. Gates: typecheck, lint 0-err, web unit 1456, build 4/4, CI green.

cards.title: Notes reachable from every appointment surface - Marcacoes 'Notas' button, hover shows the latest, ficha note links back to its marcacao
cards.notes: SHIPPED (#716, NO migration). Three surfaces: (1) MARCACOES - every row gets a 'Notas' button opening that marcacao's thread in a popup, the SAME board PL-16 renders, so a note written from the list shows in the drawer, the hover and the ficha; (2) AGENDA HOVER - it already showed the LATEST note (order by created_at desc limit 1); the projection now also carries noteCount and the label becomes 'Ultima nota (de N)' when the thread has several, so one note is never mistaken for the whole exchange (a single note keeps the plain label); (3) PATIENT FICHA - a note now names the marcacao it documents (date + therapist) and an 'Abrir marcacao' button opens it in the shared AppointmentDrawer. listPatientNotes projects the appointment link (appointment_id has always existed on appointment_notes - read/UI only); patient-level notes and legacy patient_note_revisions rows have no visit and show no line. The marcacao behind a note is fetched by id ON DEMAND (getAppointmentAction, appointments:read + RLS) in its own 'use server' module, because ./actions is imported by tests that mock next/cache with only what they need. packages/ui Dialog: confirmLabel + onConfirm are now OPTIONAL (a dialog that only PRESENTS something has nothing to confirm); every existing call site passes both, so it is additive. i18n pt+en: appointment.noteHoverLatest, patients.noteAppointment, patients.noteOpenAppointment, marcacoes.notes. Gates: typecheck, lint 0-err, web unit 1463, ui unit 76, build 4/4, CI green.

cards.title: Reception is location-pinned everywhere - no location choice, no other clinic's staff, every location input auto-applied
cards.notes: Owner CR 2026-07-31, raised first by reception: "the reception from LV cannot choose to search or input the location rather the system needs to already establish all location related actions to the one setted into the reception profile, they only see staff from their location and all inputs are automatically filled for them based on their location, everywhere on the platform across all sections and tabs". Reported symptom: "currently reception, in team schedule, agenda and other can choose from locations and are seeing all staff from both locations". FINDING (read of origin/main, not assumed): the PL-09/PL-14 machinery ALREADY treats reception exactly like admin - viewer-locations.ts:48 returns the staff_locations set for BOTH roles, getAgendaOptions narrows the location list AND the therapist roster on that scope, and every location control routes through resolveLocationControl / scopedLocationId. So this is most likely NOT a missing rule but the rule's deliberate FALLBACK: viewerLocationScope returns null (= all locations, all staff) when the staffer has ZERO staff_locations rows, so onboarding never locks anyone out. A reception account with no assignment produces exactly the reported screen. Work: (1) staged READ-ONLY prod script listing every active staff member, role and staff_locations assignment, so the cause is confirmed by pasted output rather than inferred; (2) surface-by-surface audit of every location-bearing page (agenda, horarios team schedule, marcacoes, patients, patients/new, patients/[id]/edit, invoicing, estatisticas, admin/staff Equipa, appointment-drawer, availability-panel) with a regression test per surface, closing any that still reads the tenant-wide list; (3) make the silent fallback VISIBLE - Equipa flags a reception/admin holding no location assignment, so this class of report can never again look like a code defect. Q-PL-18-1 logged for the fallback policy itself. OUTCOME 2026-07-31: the audit found NO reachable code hole for reception - viewer-locations.ts has always covered reception and admin identically, getAgendaOptions narrows the location list AND the therapist roster (PL-14), the team-schedule editor already drops its per-day select at one clinic, and /admin is unreachable by reception. The reported screen is the deliberate no-assignment FALLBACK (scope null = every clinic, every colleague). Shipped: Equipa now flags any active reception/admin holding no staff_locations row, read from staff_locations and NOT from the location chips (those are hours UNION staff_locations, so an admin with working hours shows a clinic chip while the scope still falls back to all). STILL OPEN: the staged read cyan-pl18-reception-scope-READONLY-20260731.mjs (sha256 61316869cdf56cb14120eee01007286814334273dea1f0e69a8c498ccbfc2480) proves which accounts are unassigned and answers PL-24/PL-20/PL-25 data questions in the same paste. If it shows every reception/admin already assigned, the fallback is NOT the cause and this card reopens.

cards.title: Notes on the patient ficha 'Marcacoes' tab - the same Notas button and thread popup the Marcacoes section already has
cards.notes: Owner CR 2026-07-31: "I need to extend the notes connection till the 'marcacoes' tab in the patient section, same as you have in marcacoes section add a button 'notes' where if you press a pop up with all previous notes are listed + option to add new and everything is stamped on date and time + name of creator/editor". FINDING: PL-17 (#716) put that button on every row of the MARCACOES SECTION (marcacoes-view.tsx:284) and PL-16 (#715) built the thread board, but the patient ficha's own Marcacoes tab (patients/[id]/appointments-list.tsx) has no Notas control - confirmed by read, the file has no notes import at all. Work: reuse the shipped components verbatim (packages/ui Dialog + AppointmentNotesBoard), one button per appointment row, same thread and same appointment id, so a note written on the ficha appears in the drawer, the agenda hover and the Marcacoes list. The date/time + author stamping the owner asks for is already carried by appointment_notes and rendered by the board; PL-13 (migration 0050) added the edited-by stamp. No migration, no new data path.

cards.title: Never ask for what the patient record already holds - NIF applied automatically, then a sweep of every re-asking form
cards.notes: Owner CR 2026-07-31: "there are still input forms on the platform where it is directly client related or started to be done from the patient profile, for example the declaracao document asks for NIF again although it was filled at the time of adding the patient, need to automate all these cases and don't even ask to input but auto fill and reflect at the result, bring more automation and logic, cannot be limited to NIF only". FINDING: the declaracao dialog DOES prefill from patients.nif (W12-24, DeclaracaoDialog.tsx:71) - it renders an EDITABLE input seeded with the stored value, which is what reads as being asked again, and it renders visibly empty for a patient whose NIF was never captured. Work: apply the PL-14 shape to patient data - a KNOWN value is a static line, not an input; an UNKNOWN value is asked once and what is entered is written BACK to the patient record so it is never asked a third time; an explicit 'alterar' affordance keeps the one-off override. Then sweep every form that re-asks something the patient row already carries (nome, NIF, data de nascimento, morada, telefone across documents and invoicing) and report what was found rather than guessing the list up front. The write-back is a patients:write path reception already holds. SWEEP RESULT: the declaracao NIF is the ONLY surface in the staff platform that re-asks a field the patient record already holds. Faturacao reads name/NIF/address from the patient through the InvoiceXpress mapper, the RGPD form and ficha medica are generated from the record, and Reagendar / Marcar novamente already reuse the marcacao's own therapist and location. Reported rather than padded with invented cases.

cards.title: Agendar lote - real recurrence: weekday selection, interval, end by count or by date (Rodica: the current form is too limited)
cards.notes: Owner CR 2026-07-31 via Rodica: "the current option on how you can select the frequency is very limited, you can only select if 1 per week or twice a week, they need a more complex and flexible selection form, think on how you can deliver this to them, more filters on the repetitiveness". FINDING: the drawer's lote block offers exactly two numbers - 'a cada N semanas' plus a total count - then generates same-weekday rows the user hand-edits one at a time (appointment-drawer.tsx, generateLoteDates). There is no way to express 'segundas e quintas'. The ENGINE is not the constraint: batch.ts already accepts an explicit per-slot list (V2/W2-09, built for exactly this Rodica case) beside the recurrence rule, books each slot against the SAME availability query the panel uses, and returns a structured failure with the nearest free alternative per busy slot. So this is a generator + UI change, not a scheduling-engine change. Work: weekday multi-select (seg..dom), interval in weeks, end condition = after N occurrences OR on a date, optional per-weekday time, live preview of generated rows still individually editable, MAX_OCCURRENCES 52 cap unchanged. Pure generator in lib/scheduling with unit tests, submitting through the existing explicit-slots path.

cards.title: Bloquear lote - bulk and recurring therapist schedule blocking, driven by the PL-21 recurrence form
cards.notes: Owner CR 2026-07-31: "Repetitive schedule block on therapists - need to add an option similar to what we already have in the appointment scheduling panel, 'agendar lote' bulk booking, one needs created the other improved ... then create the same thing for blocking the schedule for therapists by the reception or admins, bloquear lote or whatever". FINDING: the data model already exists - time_off (therapist-wide across locations, timestamptz so partial and multi-day both work, reason enum vacation|sick|holiday|other plus a free note) with a per-therapist editor on horarios, and blocks already suppress BOTH staff booking (conflict check) and portal slots (timeOffOverlapExists inside listOpenSlots). Reception ALREADY holds schedule:manage (permissions.ts, PL-09 Phase 5) so no capability change is needed. What is missing is creating MANY blocks in one action. Work: reuse PL-21's recurrence generator to produce N time_off rows in one submit with the same preview and per-row edit, a shared batch marker so a mistaken batch is undoable as a unit, a therapist list scoped by PL-18, and a conflict report - a block laid over an EXISTING appointment must be reported to the user, never applied silently. Depends on PL-21 for the shared generator. NOT DELIVERED, deliberately: undoing a batch as a UNIT needs a batch_id column on time_off, i.e. a second migration, and 0051 (PL-23) is already in flight - one migration at a time. Blocks stay individually removable meanwhile. Needs its own card once 0051 is applied.

cards.title: Patient health-insurance numbers - 'Numeros dos seguros de saude' on the patient form (MIGRATION, apply-before-merge)
cards.notes: Owner CR 2026-07-31: "The user data section needs to have one or more tabs where we can enter health insurance plan numbers - when adding a new patient add a new input field called 'numeros dos seguros de saude'". FINDING: patients has NO insurance column today (schema.ts) so this needs a migration - the only card in this batch that does. Shape assumption, stated rather than guessed: the owner's own plural ('numeros', plural) implies a patient may hold more than one plan, so the default built is a REPEATABLE list (one number per entry, insurer label optional) rather than a single varchar; logged as Q-PL-23-1 so it can be overruled before apply. Doctrine: apply-BEFORE-merge - build, CI green, owner applies from the osteojp-prod-apply worktree, independent read of the schema object plus the __drizzle_migrations count delta, THEN merge. Sequenced AFTER migration 0051 (the PL-15b primary_location_id backfill already carried forward) because only one migration is ever in flight at a time. 0051 APPLIED and VERIFIED on prod 2026-07-31 by the owner from the osteojp-prod-apply worktree (detached at origin/feat/PL-23-patient-insurance-numbers), THEN #726 merged - apply-before-merge satisfied. Independent read, pasted not inferred: column jsonb, nullable=NO, default=[]::jsonb; array CHECK present; 10 patient rows, 0 with a NULL; drizzle.__drizzle_migrations count 51 as expected; last hash 9adc86ad8eab1e96503aafefe4d4121247f6e93663cfcbd6b163a5517fd311b0. Q-PL-23-1 is answered BY RATIFICATION: applying the migration fixes the list shape, so changing to a single free-text field would now be a second migration over real data.

cards.title: Sexo offers Masculino and Feminino only - the 'Outro' option is removed
cards.notes: Owner CR 2026-07-31: "the sex should have only option of either man either woman, it is biological and the option 'other' is not appropriate". FINDING: patient-form.tsx offers four values - blank, male, female, other; patients.sex is a plain varchar(16) with NO database enum, so removing an option is a UI plus i18n change and needs NO migration. Work: drop the 'other' option and its pt/en string in lockstep. 'Nao especificado' (blank) STAYS - it is a data-entry state (unknown), not a third sex, and removing it would force a guess on every patient whose sex was never recorded. Any EXISTING prod row storing 'other' would render as 'Nao especificado' once the option is gone; the PL-18 staged read also counts those rows so the owner can reclassify them by hand - never guessed in SQL.

cards.title: Portal booking is on the hour - a patient can only pick 09:00, 10:00, 11:00
cards.notes: Owner CR 2026-07-31: "users should only be able to clock in/out on the hour, for example at 9:00, 10:00 - here we need to make sure on our client portal that for them the only option to book appointments is fixed hourly, they can't book at :15th minute or half of hour". FINDING: the portal never fabricates slots - they come from GET /api/v1/booking/slots -> listOpenSlots (apps/api/lib/appointments/store.ts:325), which expands each active availability template into a grid stepped by locations.slot_granularity_min (migration 0041, default 30). TWO things are needed, not one: (a) the step becomes 60, and (b) the grid must be ALIGNED to the top of the hour - the series starts at the template's own start_time, so a therapist whose hours begin 09:30 would still produce 09:30 / 10:30 at a 60-minute step. The alignment half is code and self-merges; changing the stored granularity per location is data and is hard-gated. Staff-side booking is deliberately UNCHANGED - the agenda keeps free-form times, this constrains only what a patient may self-serve. Nothing in the product edits slot_granularity_min from the UI today. Q-PL-25-1 logged for whether hourly applies to every location.

cards.title: Undo a bloquear lote batch as ONE action - time_off.batch_id + 'remover lote' (MIGRATION, apply-before-merge)
cards.notes: Owner ticketed 2026-07-31 from Q-PL-22-1, raised by GREEN when PL-22 shipped. PL-22 writes N time_off rows in ONE transaction, but nothing marks them as one batch, so undoing a mistaken recurrence means deleting every block by hand - the exact tedium bloquear lote was built to remove, reappearing on the way out. WHY IT WAS NOT IN PL-22: it needs a batch_id column, i.e. a migration, and 0051 (PL-23) was already in flight - one migration at a time. 0051 is now APPLIED and verified on prod (2026-07-31), so that constraint is gone and this is unblocked. SHAPE: a nullable `batch_id uuid` on time_off (existing blocks keep NULL - they were never a batch, and NULL is the honest value for them), stamped with one generated id per createTimeOffBlockBatch call; the blocks list groups rows sharing a batch_id and offers 'Remover lote' beside the per-row Eliminar. Deleting a batch is a normal delete of the rows in it - time_off has no append-only invariant, unlike clinical_records and record_annulments - so no new doctrine is needed, but the control must say HOW MANY blocks it will remove before it does it, and must never reach beyond the batch. Reception already holds schedule:manage, so no capability change. GATES: the usual, plus db:check-journal and db:sync-supabase:check; migration takes 0052 (the PL-15b primary_location_id backfill is still unbuilt and takes whatever number is free when it is written - numbers follow build order, not reservations). Apply-BEFORE-merge: build, CI green, owner applies from the osteojp-prod-apply worktree with git checkout origin/<branch> detached, independent read of the column plus the __drizzle_migrations count delta, THEN merge.
